newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse falls on week, banks main movers.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse falls on week, banks main movers.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index ended the week lower on Friday, with banks the main movers, its market report showed.
The All-Share Index fell 2.5 points to 346.66 points. It fell 8.89 points or almost 2.5 percent to 349.16 points on Wednesday from Monday's 358.05 points. It ended the previous week at 357.21.
Turnover was the best of the week with 454,630 shares changing hands compared to Monday's 86,700 shares and Wednesday's 276,940. Offers outstripped bids by 3,070,030 to 1,658,420.
Standard Chartered Bank fell 400 cedis to 4,600 cedis. Enterprise Insurance Company (-20 to 450), UNILEVER (-15 to 760) and Accra Brewery Limited (-1 to 594) were the other declining issues.

Ghana Commercial Bank, the main decliner on Wednesday when it shed 80 cedis, rose 10 cedis to 630. Social Security Bank (+10 to 1,090), UTC-Estates (+10 to 60) and Home Finance Company (+4 to 140) were the other risers.
